name: fems-monorepo
description: TZW LTD Fire Extinguisher Management System - RESTful microservices platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "USER,AUTH,EXT,INSP,REPORT,NOTIFY,REQ,GW,UI" --prefix-colors "red,blue,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,orange,gray,green" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:ext" "npm run dev:insp" "npm run dev:report" "npm run dev:notify" "npm run dev:request" "npm run dev:gw" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/user-service && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../extinguisher-service && npm install && cd ../inspection-service && npm install && cd ../reporting-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../../gateway && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
